title: Glasgow, Scotland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Glasgow, Scotland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Glasgow is a city in Scotland with a population of 635,640. Scotland’s largest city known for its art scene, friendly locals, and some of the most affordable urban living in the UK. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 126 sunny days a year.
